evidence.text:

The Committee on Appropriations recommended non-concurrence.

4 · Preservation, checks and remaining limit
evidence.text:
All 1,094 project tests pass, including 15 focused checks for complete and uncertain replies, the actual saved failure, mixed prompt/schema versions and original request reconstruction. The original prompt, schema and S5 request still reproduce byte for byte. The earlier model result, its invalid status and both spent call slots remain unchanged.

The new candidate request uses the same original S5 scan and text, one complete paragraph target and the existing model/output ceiling. Its stricter prompt and schema are saved for inspection. Image/source links, feedback checks, number routing and uncertainty safeguards remain in place.

This establishes software agreement. Whether the installed model follows this stricter schema in a real call remains untested. A future actual test needs its own exact authorization; no retry or new call follows automatically. Comments are optional.
